text: Gomɗii Men tippinii e mooɗon -onon yimɓe ɓen- Aayeeje ɓannguɗe jilɓuya alah e majje, Men tippini e mooɗon misal immorde e ɓen feƴƴunooɓe ado mooɗon immorde e gomɗinɓe e heeferɓe, Men tippini e mooɗon waaju ɓen hulooɓe Joomi mu'un hiɓe waajitora ngu ɗoftagol Yamraaɗi Makko ɗin e woɗɗitagol haɗaaɗi Makko ɗin.
